ui.demo.title: UI kit
ui.demo.lead: Artist Tree primitives. Compose screens from these — do not one-off restyle.
ui.demo.buttons_lead: Primary · secondary · outline · ghost · danger · outline-danger. Sizes sm / md / lg. Disabled at 45% opacity.
ui.demo.inputs_lead: Label, control slot, helper or error. Focus ring uses primary teal.
ui.demo.label: Label
ui.demo.toasts_lead: Success / error / info. Setup danger toast uses the same system.
ui.demo.toast.error_body: Check the form and try again.
ui.demo.textarea_lead: Same focus ring and invalid state as Input. Resize vertically.
ui.demo.textarea_hint: Shown on the artist advancing sheet.
ui.demo.select_lead: Styled native select. Teal focus ring; danger border when invalid.
ui.demo.controls_lead: Native checkbox and radio with teal accent. Switch is a labelled toggle.
ui.demo.badges_lead: Neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, and outline. Pill is tag-like.
ui.demo.tags_lead: Jira-style labels. Token colors or a custom hex via name + color props.
ui.demo.icons_lead: Font Awesome Free via the Icon wrapper. Register icons in resources/js/icons.js (tree-shakeable).
